purpose: Review expectations, not an Oyzu configuration or shipped protocol schema.
preparation: Package metadata, archives, integrity records and the selected manager distribution.
Native-addon toolchains and any supported lifecycle assets, including browser binaries, captured separately from script execution.

credentialBoundary.upstreamCredentials: broker only; never exposed to project or dependency scripts
credentialBoundary.packageBytes: executor-side agent directly to approved upstream; no mandatory platform byte relay
credentialBoundary.brokerAccess: job-scoped route limited to approved repositories; no shared unauthenticated endpoint
credentialBoundary.execution: captured inputs; networking denied independently of manager offline flags
credentialBoundary.cache: credential-free captured content; private-content authorization rechecked on reuse

platforms.selection: Capture OS/architecture/runtime/ABI-compatible inputs; executor availability is checked, never inferred from host support.

evidence: approved source identity without credential-bearing URLs
